title: The Concept of Quantum Entanglement
text:
Quantum entanglement describes a phenomenon where two or more particles become linked in such a way that they share the same existence, regardless of the physical distance separating them. Measuring a property (like spin) on one entangled particle instantaneously influences the corresponding property of the other, seemingly violating classical notions of locality.

Einstein famously dubbed this 'spooky action at a distance' because the correlation appears to happen faster than the speed of light. While it does not permit faster-than-light communication—as no information can be transmitted solely through the entanglement itself—it forms the bedrock for emerging technologies like quantum computing and secure quantum cryptography.

The study of entanglement challenges fundamental assumptions about reality, suggesting that properties often do not exist definitively until they are measured.
